avatar3d.body.aviso.ARMS_ON_TORSO: An arm touches the torso: the width at that height is hidden.
avatar3d.body.aviso.CLOTHING: Clothing at the silhouette edge: widths are the clothing's, marked as estimates.
avatar3d.body.aviso.FEET_HIDDEN: The feet are not visible: without the height in the photo, nothing of the body is measured.
avatar3d.body.aviso.HEAD_CUT: The top of the head is cut off.
avatar3d.body.aviso.NOT_FRONTAL: The person is turned: widths become estimates.
avatar3d.body.aviso.NOT_PROFILE: The photo is not a side view: depth was not measured.
avatar3d.body.aviso.NOT_STANDING: Not a standing pose (stride, seated or leaning): legs and hips become estimates.
avatar3d.body.aviso.PERSPECTIVE: Head too large relative to the body in the photo: likely lens distortion.
avatar3d.body.aviso.TIGHT_FRAMING: The person fills the whole photo: move the camera back (a close lens distorts proportions).
avatar3d.body.dica1: Facing the camera, standing, arms slightly away from the body.
avatar3d.body.dica2: Head to feet in the frame, with a little room above and below.
avatar3d.body.dica3: Fitted clothes: loose clothing becomes an estimate, not a measurement.
avatar3d.body.dica4: Camera at chest height, about 2 to 3 meters away (avoids lens distortion).
avatar3d.body.dica_perfil1: Sideways, standing, looking ahead, arms relaxed along your body.
avatar3d.body.dica_perfil2: Head to feet in frame, same framing as the front photo.
avatar3d.body.dica_perfil3: Close-fitting clothes: from the side, loose clothes still become an estimate.
avatar3d.body.duas_pessoas: There is more than one person in the photo: we cannot tell whose body it is.
avatar3d.body.explica: Body proportions come from a full-body photo (optional), the height you enter and your adjustments. Each measurement shows where it came from. Weight and age are not measured from the photo.
avatar3d.body.falhou: We could not measure the photo right now. Try again.
avatar3d.body.m.aviso: Numbers check the file and the alignment, not likeness: compare the avatar with the photo side by side before saving.
avatar3d.body.m.completude: Complete body: {v} of the parts (head, neck, torso, arms, hands, legs, feet)
avatar3d.body.m.conexoes: Connected parts (largest gap: {v} mm; negative = one sits inside the other)
avatar3d.body.m.pontos: Joints vs photo, after alignment: error {v} of the torso · {pck} within 10%
avatar3d.body.m.proporcoes: Difference from the photo measurements: {v} (over {n} measurements)
avatar3d.body.m.silhueta: Torso and legs silhouette vs photo (IoU): {v}. Loose clothing in the photo lowers this number.
avatar3d.body.nao_e_perfil: This photo is not a side view: both shoulders are apart. Turn sideways to the camera.
avatar3d.body.perfil_explica: The side photo is the only one that shows how deep your torso is (belly, glutes, bust). Without it, depth is derived from width — a design estimate, not a measurement of you.
avatar3d.body.peso_idade: Height is used as you enter it. Weight only suggests the build when the photo did not measure the widths; age does not change the avatar.
avatar3d.body.profundidade_estimada: No side photo: derived from width. Upload a side photo or adjust it by hand.
avatar3d.body.regiao.head: head
avatar3d.body.sem_foto_comparar: Upload a full-body photo to compare the avatar with it, side by side.
avatar3d.body.sem_pessoa: We could not find a full person in this photo. Try another one, facing the camera and standing.
avatar3d.issue.BLURRY: The photo is shaky or out of focus.
avatar3d.issue.DEEP_SHADOWS: Harsh shadows hide part of the face.
avatar3d.issue.DEPTH_ESTIMATED: Made from one photo: face depth (nose, chin, profile) is estimated.
avatar3d.issue.FACE_CUT: The face is cut off at the edge of the photo.
avatar3d.issue.FACE_OCCLUDED: Something covers part of the face ({pct}%): hand, hair, sunglasses or a mask.
avatar3d.issue.FACE_SMALL: The face is small in the photo ({px} px wide). Move the camera closer.
avatar3d.issue.HAIR_CUT: The top of the head is cut off in the photo, so the hair volume was estimated.
avatar3d.issue.HAIR_UNSURE: We couldn't separate the hair from the background well. Check the hair in the preview.
avatar3d.issue.HEAD_UP_DOWN: Keep your head level, not looking up or down ({deg}°).
avatar3d.issue.LOOK_AT_CAMERA: In the front photo, look at the camera (the face is turned {deg}°).
avatar3d.issue.MOUTH_OPEN: The mouth is open. A neutral expression is more faithful.
avatar3d.issue.MULTIPLE_FACES: There are {n} faces in the photo. Send a photo of just you.
avatar3d.issue.NEED_FRONT: The front photo is missing, and it's required.
avatar3d.issue.NO_FACE: We couldn't find a face in this photo.
avatar3d.issue.ONE_SIDE_ONLY: Older avatar made with a 3/4 photo of one side only.
avatar3d.issue.OTHER: This photo needs adjusting. Try another.
avatar3d.issue.SIDE_LIGHT: The light comes mostly from one side. Face the window or the light.
avatar3d.issue.TOO_BRIGHT: The photo is too bright: parts of the face are blown out.
avatar3d.issue.TOO_DARK: The photo is dark. Find more light from the front.
avatar3d.issue.TURN_LESS: In the 3/4 photo, turn a bit less: the face is almost in profile ({deg}°).
avatar3d.issue.TURN_MORE: In the 3/4 photo, turn your face a bit more (only {deg}°).
